C1396.title: Silex Botnet Attack Damages IoT Devices with Default Credentials
C1396.summary: On June 25, 2019, an Akamai researcher discovered Silexbot in a honeypot. The malware scanned internet-accessible IoT devices that still used known default login credentials. After gaining access, it deleted system files, network configuration, and firewall rules before halting the device, leaving it unable to boot or connect normally. Recovery generally required manually reflashing the firmware.
